newsitem.title: USA: CACI gets $22.5 mln Navy contract.
newsitem.headline: CACI gets $22.5 mln Navy contract.

text.p: CACI International Inc said Wednesday it has received a five-year contract estimated at $22.5 million from the commander of the U.S. Navy's Atlantic Fleet Integrated Logistics Overhaul Activity in Portsmouth, Virginia.

The time-and-materials award calls for CACI to provide logistics and automated data processing support for ships upgrading and replacing equipment during logistics overhaul activities, the company said.

CACI, which has been supporting the Portsmouth program under a similar contract since 1992, expects to start additional work in mid-March in support of ILO activity at Atlantic Fleet detachments in New London, Connecticut and Jacksonville, Florida.
CACI's contract calls on it to ensure that Atlantic Fleet logistics records are accurate and that ADP systems adequately support logistics functions.
